research_question: Does the exact frozen 1M M32x8 IVF-PQ deployment index expose enough PQ-specific, query-distributed Recall@100 headroom to justify implementing a new Top-10-protected, Top-100-repair PQ-aware objective?
scope: outcome-informed MS MARCO 1M development diagnostic only; no adapter fitting, encoder training, PQ/codebook update, RARS fitting, future-role evaluation, external confirmation, deployment claim, or paper claim

positioning.passing_authorizes_only: implementation and preregistration of a separate v6 loss-development experiment
positioning.failing_means: the frozen 1M M32x8 setting does not provide the preregistered quantity and breadth of PQ-specific development signal

data_policy.dataset: deterministic qrels-preserving 1M MS MARCO passage development corpus

allowed_inputs: positive qrels for exactly these query IDs
diagnostic_role.allowed_use: headroom, flip-support, and resource diagnostics only

shared_qrels_container.zero_or_missing_qrels_semantics: not relevant unless an explicit positive judgment exists

forbidden_roles.oracle_audit: no arrays, labels, candidates, or metrics may be opened or computed by v6
forbidden_roles.future_method_holdout: no arrays, labels, candidates, or metrics may be opened or computed by v6

data_policy.negative_semantics: a candidate absent from positive qrels is an unjudged mined challenger, never an explicit non-relevant document

diagnostic_configuration.full_exact_definition: FP32 inner-product search over every one of the 1M corpus vectors
diagnostic_configuration.ivf_exact_definition: FP32 inner-product search restricted to the exact same nprobe=16 IVF lists selected for each query
diagnostic_configuration.base_pq_definition: canonical frozen Faiss CPU IndexIVFPQ search with nprobe=16; the CPU coarse-quantizer probe IDs are reused by ivf_exact
diagnostic_configuration.flip_triplet_definition: an explicit-positive versus unjudged challenger around the base rank-100 boundary for which the FP32 same-probe margin is positive and the reconstructed-PQ margin is non-positive

signal_gate.interpretation: The triplet threshold is an engineering signal gate. It is not a statistical-significance test and cannot replace a later query-paired confidence interval.

prohibited_actions: editing this protocol after observing the first v6 headroom metric
opening oracle_audit or future_method_holdout arrays, labels, candidates, or metrics
fitting or updating an adapter, encoder, IVF centroid, PQ codebook, PQ code, or RARS sidecar
calling an unjudged challenger explicitly non-relevant
using Base Recall below an arbitrary threshold as a substitute for PQ-specific headroom
treating 500 flip triplets as proof of significance
claiming official MS MARCO performance, external confirmation, deployment readiness, or SIGIR readiness
